title: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort, as Treasury widens sanctions
summary_full: Iran said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, as the U.S. escalates sanctions aimed at cutting off Tehran's financial lifelines.
